gen-gf-baumans-gf-kadwa: Kadwa, a text serif with open-ended curves and a larger x-height, sits beneath the crescent-wrench c of Baumans. Kadwa is built for carrying text, while Baumans, free of any stroke shading, is built for making a statement.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noticia-text: A c like a wrench opened wide gives Baumans its character, with every stroke ruler-straight in weight. Noticia Text, a serif with big curved entrances and lowercase filling most of the letter height, adds literary dignity.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-piazzolla: Refined and authoritative, Piazzolla takes the text under Baumans. Baumans does best when its uniform strokes and wrench-shaped c get noticed, while Piazzolla does best with lowercase nearly matching its capitals.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-pridi: Refined and classic, Pridi lets its small letters stand almost as tall as capitals. But the real draw is the height gap, since Baumans keeps its lowercase moderate and gives every stroke equal weight.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-scope-one: Hairline-free strokes and a wide wrench-like c define Baumans. Scope One, with counters that spill outward and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, makes extended reading feel sturdy and traditional.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-slabo-13px: No calligraphic modulation anywhere: that is Baumans. Slabo 13px is a serif with large open counters and bookish dignity, so leave its size modest and let Baumans do the shouting.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and editorial, Suwannaphum stands tall with a paperclip-open c and a high, squared-off x-height. But the real draw is Baumans, whose thin-looking letters never get thinner anywhere along a stroke.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab brings a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase beneath Bellota. Epunda Slab does the quiet work of carrying text, while Bellota, every stroke traced at one stylus width, takes the spotlight.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-fauna-one: Literary and dignified, Fauna One has a tall middle band with shallow ascenders and descenders. Fauna One supplies the text while Bellota, with its far-hanging s ends, earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, its big counters and unclosed curved mouths keeping every letter open. And Bellota's bent-wire round letters make a lively foil, so give Glegoo a size that lets its tall lowercase breathe.
